per_question.question: What was the total net revenue in 2024?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.net_amount END), 2) AS net_revenue FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2024 LIMIT 200

per_question.question: How many orders did we get in 2025?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.order_id END), 2) AS order_count FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 LIMIT 200

per_question.question: Top 5 cities by net revenue in 2025
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT c.city AS city, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.net_amount END), 2) AS net_revenue FROM gold.fact_sales AS f JOIN gold.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN gold.dim_customer AS c ON f.customer_sk = c.customer_sk WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

per_question.question: Which payment method has the most orders?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT f.payment_method AS payment_method, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.order_id END), 2) AS order_count FROM gold.fact_sales AS f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

per_question.question: What is the average order value for UPI vs COD?
per_question.predicted_sql: SELECT f.payment_method AS payment_method, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.is_revenue THEN f.order_id END), 2) AS average_order_value FROM gold.fact_sales AS f WHERE f.payment_method IN ('COD', 'UPI') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 200
